title: Generali raises Future Generali India stake to 74%
body: Assicurazioni Generali has increased its shareholding in Future Generali India Insurance Company from 49% to 74%, after buying an additional 25% from Future Enterprises Limited. Generali first invested in the venture in 2007. Future Enterprises, which held 29% before the sale, is left with 4%. The deal received regulatory clearance in April 2025.
